qualifier: microtubule nucleation and anchoring at the centrosome
name: Centrosomal microtubule nucleation, anchoring and spindle orientation
rationale: Members concern nucleating and anchoring microtubules at the centrosome and positioning centrosome, astral microtubules and spindle (asymmetric division); unlike confusables it lacks neuroblast, cilium/centriole duplication, tubulin modification and mitotic centrosome maturation content.

name: Inherited cytochrome P450 and membrane transporter defect disorders
rationale: All members are monogenic diseases from defective P450 enzymes (CYP1B1, CYP2U1, CYP7B1, TBXAS1) or transporters (SLC33A1, SLCO2A1, ABCB6), whereas confusables center on eicosanoid, bile acid or cholesterol biosynthesis pathways.

name: Circulating monocyte surface and activation signatures
rationale: Members are monocyte/myeloid enrichment modules, monocyte surface signatures and monocyte activation/differentiation, distinguished from dendritic cell, neutrophil degranulation/inflammation and monocyte extravasation confusables.

name: Pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide monophosphate catabolism
rationale: Members are catabolism of UMP, dUMP, dTMP, dGMP, dCMP and deoxyribonucleosides, separating the theme from pyrimidine biosynthesis/salvage and purine deoxynucleoside metabolism confusables.

core: Chaperone protein refolding and quality control
qualifier: nitrosative stress, autophagic and mitochondrial triage
name: Chaperone refolding and degradation triage under nitrosative stress
rationale: Members cover chaperone refolding, ER folding, chaperone-mediated autophagy/aggrephagy and blocking mitochondrial targeting under nitrosative and manganese stress, unlike the heat shock/HSF1, UPRmt and de novo folding confusables.

name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell engulfment
rationale: Members concern microglial differentiation, activation, proliferation and cytotoxicity plus recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells, which the astrocyte/glial apoptosis and amyloid clearance confusables lack.

name: ER contact-site tethering and phosphatidylinositol lipid transfer
rationale: Members describe ER tethering to plasma membrane, mitochondria and autophagosomes with intermembrane phospholipid transfer and PI/PIP synthesis, distinct from Golgi vesicle traffic and ER tubular network confusables.

name: Cardiac fibroblast differentiation and connective tissue replacement
rationale: All three members concern fibroblast/myofibroblast differentiation and connective tissue replacement in the heart, unlike the smooth muscle, cardiomyocyte and wound-healing confusables.

name: Nucleosome assembly, disassembly and CHD1/2 chromatin remodeling
rationale: Members cover nucleosome organization, replication-dependent assembly, protein-DNA complex disassembly and CHD1/2 remodelers, distinguishing it from CENP-A centromeric and BAF complex confusables.

qualifier: dendritic cell IL-12 and IFN-gamma production
name: Dendritic cell-driven Th1 polarization and IFN-gamma production
rationale: Members span dendritic cell IL-12/cytokine production, Th1 differentiation, IFN-gamma production/response and MHC upregulation, versus confusables focused on IFNG signal regulation, IL-12 JAK-STAT, NKT or Treg biology.

name: Neural plate patterning and floor plate development
rationale: Members concern neural plate/fold formation, regionalization and neural fate with floor plate and ventral midline development, which the neural plate border and spinal cord patterning confusables lack.

name: Arginine catabolism and ornithine-citrulline urea cycle regulation
rationale: Members cover arginine catabolism, ornithine, citrulline and aspartate metabolism, ornithine carrier defects and repression of urea cycle enzymes, rather than the core urea cycle enzymes, cationic transport or glutamate metabolism of confusables.

qualifier: neurexin-neuroligin at excitatory and inhibitory synapses
name: Neurexin-neuroligin postsynaptic assembly at excitatory and inhibitory synapses
rationale: Members describe neuroligin-linked clustering of NMDA, PSD-95, gephyrin and GABA receptors and tuning of excitatory/inhibitory potentials, unlike confusables centred on presynaptic and SALM/RPTP adhesion or LGI-ADAM.

name: Excitatory synaptic transmission via kainate, AMPA and nicotinic receptors
rationale: Members describe activation of kainate, AMPA and nicotinic ionotropic receptors with receptor trapping and presynaptic excitability, distinct from confusables on transmitter secretion and inhibitory synapse assembly.

name: Neurotransmitter release cycles of monoamines, glutamate and acetylcholine
rationale: Members are the transmitter-specific release cycles plus vesicle docking, whereas confusables describe regulation of vesicle priming, fusion and exocytosis.

name: Filopodial actin bundling, severing and capping
rationale: Members concern actin crosslinking, bundling, severing, capping and filopodium regulation (including postsynaptic actin), unlike the lamellipodium, ruffle and motility confusables.

name: Urea cycle and its inherited enzyme deficiencies
rationale: All members are urea cycle biosynthesis steps or deficiencies of its enzymes (CPS1, OTC, ASS1, ASL, ARG1, NAGS), which confusables lack.

name: DNA glycosylase-initiated base excision repair and its defects
rationale: Members are glycosylase recognition, AP site processing, short and long patch base excision repair and defective glycosylase variants, distinct from alkylation reversal and DNA demethylation confusables.

name: Catecholamine and serotonin synthesis, degradation and sympathoadrenal development
rationale: Members cover catecholamine and serotonin biosynthesis, MAO/COMT degradation and adrenal/sympathetic development, while confusables center on monoamine transport/uptake or BH4 cofactor.

name: G1/S checkpoint control and its tumor-suppressor defects
rationale: Members describe CDK4/6-cyclin D-RB1 G1/S control and its cancer loss-of-function defects (p16INK4A, p14ARF, RB1, TP53), unlike confusables on TP53 transcriptional regulation, senescence or G2/M.

qualifier: oxidized LDL and foam cell formation
name: Scavenger receptor clearance and oxidized LDL foam cell formation
rationale: Members are scavenging by class A/B/F/H receptors, oxidized LDL responses and foam cell/cholesterol storage, distinguishing it from apoptotic cell and hyaluronan clearance confusables.

name: Osmotic stress responses and sodium transport regulation
rationale: Members cover hyper/hypo-osmotic and salt stress responses with regulation of renal and transmembrane sodium/potassium transport, versus vasopressin water and cation-chloride cotransporter/K channel confusables.

name: BAF chromatin remodeling, nucleosome assembly and histone acetylation
rationale: Members cover BAF complex formation, nucleosome assembly/disassembly and protein lysine acetylation, which distinguish it from CENP-A, NuRD/CHD6-9 and acetylation-regulation confusables.

name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis, cytotoxicity and inhibitory signaling
rationale: Members describe Fc-gamma receptor activation, phagocytosis, ADCC, hypersensitivity and inhibitory FcR/CD22 B cell regulation, versus BCR, neutrophil, Fc-epsilon mast cell and myeloid confusables.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell and thymocyte homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate HSC proliferation and bone marrow cell numbers together with thymocyte proliferation, survival and differentiation, which confusables lack.
